visual_observations: Reviewed six same-camera shape views, twelve motion/stop views, and six skirt-hidden shorts views.
Compared original costume illustration and prior generated front view: narrowed the exaggerated umbrella opening and lowered the side hem while retaining waist and layered lace trim.
Final walk/stop front and side views closely retain the new authored silhouette; no reviewed whole-skirt inversion remains.
Jogging peak raises the leading skirt panel substantially; final stopped views return to the compact standing shape. Minor trim curvature and local ripples remain.
Connected opaque black shorts cover the crotch in the reviewed wide crouch, diagonal crouch and right lunge views.
limitations: No gameplay animations or runtime video captured; agent did not launch, control or stop the game.
Offline recovery is not a runtime guarantee. Some deep-action clipping remains.
Blender does not emulate native PBZ shading, wind, animation transitions, LOD or teleport behavior.
